title.description: Publication title from the cover, e.g. 'Current Intelligence Bulletin'

issuing_office.description: Office and agency named on the cover

bulletin_date.description: Date of the issue as printed on the cover, e.g. '25 January 1957'

copy_number.description: Copy No. printed on the cover

classification.description: Original security classification marked on the pages, e.g. 'TOP SECRET'

release.description: The declassification release stamp printed at the top and foot of each page

release_date.description: Date in 'Approved for Release: YYYY/MM/DD', as YYYY-MM-DD

document_id.description: The document identifier after the release date, e.g. 'C03161983'

contents.description: Every numbered item in the CONTENTS list, in order, plus the annex

item_number.description: The item's number in the list; null for the annex

headline.description: The item's headline as printed, without the page reference

redacted.description: true if a blank declassification box appears in or after the headline

articles.description: Each numbered article in the body of the bulletin

key_figures.description: Monetary amounts or other figures stated in the article, as printed, e.g. '$50,000,000'

comment_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the article's 'Comment' paragraph, or null if it has none
